results.title: Uttarakhand Cabinet clears High Court land transfer, Ganga Expressway extension
results.description: The Cabinet approved the signing of a memorandum of understanding between the Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand governments to extend the Ganga Expressway to Haridwar.
